title: Saikyou no Kensei, Bishoujo Maid ni Tensei Shi Houki de Musou Suru
titleRomaji: Saikyou no Kensei, Bishoujo Maid ni Tensei Shi Houki de Musou Suru
titleNative: 最強の剣聖、美少女メイドに転生し箒で無双する
synonyms: The strongest sword saint is reincarnated as a beautiful maid and becomes unrivaled with a broom
synopsis: Arnoick, the strongest Sword Saint in history, has died. His sword techniques were passed on to his disciples, and it was thought that his story had come to an end— But then…! Arnoick is reincarnated as a breathtakingly beautiful maid named Annette! With her slender arms and frail body, she should have given up the path of the sword and lived a quiet, peaceful life. However, in order to protect Rosalena, the daughter of a fallen noble family, she rises up broom in hand. An ultimate do-over fantasy of the strongest warrior reborn—from old man to beautiful girl! (Comic Gardo Translated)

titleNative: オオカミは月に恋をする
synopsis: Ryuna Kamikawa is the beautiful and perfect-acting student council president. When she gets angry at her lazy vice-president, Yugi Tsukiyama, he likes to tease her by calling "wolf-senpai." The two are like the light and dark sides of the moon, total opposites who don't get along. Until one day, when Tsukiyama discovers the hidden side of "Wolf Senpai" through his secret part-time job...? This is the start of a love story between two people with hidden identities! (Source: Ura Sunday, translated)

title: Densetsu no Yankee wa Elite Salaryman!?
titleRomaji: Densetsu no Yankee wa Elite Salaryman!?
titleNative: 伝説のヤンキーはエリートサラリーマン!?
synonyms: The Legendary bad boy is an elite office worker!?
synopsis: "Please make me your disciple!!!" Souta, who was about to graduate from high school, felt frustrated that he hadn't become the kind of ideal delinquent he had always imagined. On his way home one day, a lame-looking office worker with a neatly parted hairstyle and glasses who had gotten into trouble with Souta's delinquent friends ended up completely defeating them! To his shock, that office worker turned out to be Morohoshi Keigo, the legendary delinquent Souta had always admired! From that day on, Souta starts visiting Morohoshi whenever he has free time, determined to become his apprentice. Why did he quit being a delinquent? Why is he pretending to be such a lame office worker? As Souta finds himself constantly thinking about Morohoshi, his feelings begin to change in an unexpected way...?! (Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title: NonNonBa
titleNative: のんのんばあとオレ
synopsis: Autobiographical tale in which Mizuki narrates the memories of his childhood in the decade of 1930, in Sakaiminato, a small coastal town at the southwest Japan. With nostalgia and tenderness, the mangaka narrates his first years of life within a modest family, the fights with his friends,the school and his first loves. The title character of the book, NonNonBa, is an old mystical and superstitious woman by which Shigeru discovers the world of yokai, supernatural beings and grotesque bestiary of medieval Japanese. Won Best Album at the 2007 Angoulême International Comics Festival.

synopsis: Tateo Sone runs a pharmacy in Odawara and leads an ordinary but happy life with his beautiful wife and daughter-in-law. One day, however, when his wife tells him she is pregnant, he is shocked. It's because he has a secret: he has never had a functioning lower half of his body. His wife's child is not his own...Tateo despairs at the thought. At that time, a man named Sumaoka happens to give him a mysterious ED drug. Tateo impulsively takes the drug and is shocked to find that the function of his lower body miraculously recovers. Tateo declares to Sumaoka that he will recreate and make this medicine himself. But this is the beginning of a dangerous day that will change his life forever! (Source: Big Comic, translated)
